record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace standardized log-frequency modulation with training-item frequency percentile modulation: scale real-item inputs by 1 + 0.02*(2*p-1), where p is the midrank percentile of each item's training count across the real-item vocabulary. This tests a bounded frequency feature less sensitive to count outliers. Keep padding and mask scales at 1, store scales in each checkpoint, and preserve learned embeddings, topology, readout, loss and optimizer. Retain one model per category.
